endorsements.name: Paras Bhatia
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-36881
endorsements.description: Flexsense DiskBoss 7.7.14 contains a local buffer overflow vulnerability in the 'Input Directory' component that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on the system. Attackers can exploit this by pasting a specially crafted directory path into the 'Add Input Directory' field.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.6)
